items.example: Let me think … I'd probably choose the quieter café.

note.en: Better than a long silence in Speaking.
note.es: Mejor que un silencio largo en Speaking.

items.example: Well, I usually go to the gym after work, but it depends on the day.
That's a good question. I haven't decided where to go on holiday yet.
Let me see … I think I last visited my cousins in March.

items.phrase: Give me a moment to think about that.
items.example: Give me a moment to think about that. I'd like to give you a proper answer.
How can I put it? The job is interesting, but the pay isn't great.

note.en: Use when you are searching for the right words.
note.es: Úsalo cuando buscas las palabras adecuadas.

items.phrase: I haven't really thought about that, but …
items.example: I haven't really thought about that, but I suppose public transport would be cheaper.
What I mean is, people don't have time to cook every day.
That's a tricky one, but I'd lean towards working from home.

note.en: Shows you are weighing the answer before you give it.
note.es: Muestra que estás sopesando la respuesta antes de darla.

items.phrase: It's not easy to put into words, but …
items.example: It's not easy to put into words, but the city felt both exciting and calm.

items.phrase: Off the top of my head, …
items.example: Off the top of my head, I'd say about two hundred people came.

note.en: You give a quick answer without checking.
note.es: Das una respuesta rápida sin comprobarla.

items.phrase: If I could just consider that for a moment, …
items.example: If I could just consider that for a moment, I believe the second option is more realistic.
